methodology: Initial issuer ticker/name catalogue curated as discovery leads. Exact current issuer name, sector, listing status and code require profile or official bulk reconciliation; not a census of live listed securities. No current financials, price, market cap or shareholding imputed. First issuer entries with independently source-linked FY2025 fundamentals: MEDC (company investor table), TLKM and PTBA (existing SLI reviewed group reports). These are isolated reporting periods, not live market quotes; unavailable fields remain null. Added BBRI FY2025 total assets and consolidated income for the year using the issuer's financial highlights; banking revenue is not imputed from interest income. Dataset coverage is displayed by sector; missing means unverified, not zero.
